dysonprotocol.storage.v1.QueryParamsRequ.title: Query Params Request
dysonprotocol.storage.v1.QueryParamsRequ.description: Empty request for retrieving current storage module parameters.

params.description: Current module parameters including MaxStorageSize and StorageStakeMultiple.

dysonprotocol.storage.v1.QueryParamsResp.title: Query Params Response
dysonprotocol.storage.v1.QueryParamsResp.description: Response containing the current storage module parameters.

max_storage_size.description: max_storage_size defines the maximum storage size in bytes that can be stored per owner

storage_stake_multiple.description: storage_stake_multiple defines the stake requirement multiplier per byte stored. Value "0" disables stake requirements entirely.

dysonprotocol.storage.v1.Params.title: Params
dysonprotocol.storage.v1.Params.description: Params defines the parameters for the storage module.
